name: Pec Deck
grip: Neutral or semi-pronated grip holding the vertical padded machine handles.
description: Sit upright against the back pad of a pec deck machine and adduct both arms horizontally toward the center line in a controlled hugging arc.
setup: Adjust seat height so the handles align across mid-chest level when gripped.
Sit with hips, upper back, and head firmly supported against the vertical back pad.
Grip the vertical handles with a slight, fixed bend in the elbows.
instructions: Contract the chest muscles to bring the lever handles together in front of the sternum.
Maintain the same soft elbow angle throughout the horizontal arc; do not turn the fly into a press.
Squeeze the chest at full adduction for a brief pause.
Slowly return the arms back to the starting stretch position under control without letting the weight stack slam.
cues: Keep upper back pinned to the pad.
Lead with the inner elbows and chest.
commonMistakes: Pressing with the triceps by straightening the elbows during adduction.
Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears.
Overextending the arms backward past active shoulder mobility at the stretch.

logging.example: Pin placed at 45 kg: record 45 kg selected machine load.
logging.note: Machine lever arms, cams, and pulley ratios vary widely across manufacturers; record the selected stack pin load.
